svg.aria-label: Plan: Requirements, architecture and UX for whole applications. A business problem becomes a scoped plan. Build: Features across frontend and backend, covered by unit, E2E and visual regression tests. Run: Infrastructure on AWS and Azure with Terraform. CI/CD, monitoring and releases. Improve: Rollout with the team, then measure in production and iterate
